keyFindings.description: A close skips a document whose history cannot load, leaving its blocks open in storage. The rebuild that 409 DOCUMENT_UNLOADABLE offers is allowed on a closed issue without markdown (rebuild.go:88-90) and seeds from the latest version, which predates the close, so the blocks read state="open" again; RebuildTx marks no settlement owed, so the repair (issue_ask_repair.go candidates) reaches the issue only if another of its documents happens to owe one. The closed issue's document then shows an open decision whose row says withdrawn.

A later admission calls PendingSync.admitted straight from onAuthenticated, before the reconnect's sync step is applied (synced is never reset). A read-only-to-writable admission then runs admit's restore against a stale document: another tab's stored row that builds on items the server took meanwhile parks in the scratch copy, is dropped with the handled rows and sets rebuiltAt, so that tab's unsent typing is lost and the page reports a rebuild that did not happen. The first admission waits for sync (notifySynced); later ones must too.

The PATCH row lists the daemon's outbox SetStatus/HandOver but not the daemon API's other status writes that can reopen a closed issue and so meet the new 503: the controller's set_status (packages/daemon/internal/api/issues.go:31) and rerun_child (architect.go:909, todo) and release_children (architect.go:532), each answering the agent 502. The AskResolution row omits the margin sheet (useMarginSheet.ts:45), which folds only retracted asks, so a withdrawn ask stays in the margin unfolded.
